notes.title: Realpolitiks II Update Live and More News about the Franchise!
notes.notes:
Greetings, world leaders!

We have amazing news for you today: Thanks to our work on the new sequel, Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond, we have been able to incorporate some of the newly developed tools and technologies to Realpolitiks II, fixing a major issue that we have not been able to address before - the dreaded time-freeze bug. This will prevent any new occurrences of the bug, but if your game has already been affected by it, you may unfortunately have to load an earlier save or start a new game, as not every save file will be fixed. Besides squashing this major bug, we looked into minor rebalancing of AI and other small fixes as well.

We will be looking for even more opportunities to use the tools and engine upgrades newly developed for Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond to improve the original games as well. We hope to prove to you that the development of the new game is good news for the franchise overall; while we are pushing the series forward with the new installment, we do not want to just forget about its roots.

New Details about Realpolitiks 3: Earth and Beyond

However, we also want to make full use of the new engine and bring forth features and gameplay options that simply are not possible to implement into the originals. We would like to take a moment to introduce some of the many possibilities you can look forward to when the game launches later this year. That is why we have prepared a first in the series of devlogs - check it out here.

We will be sharing even more news and sneak peeks soon - if you want to stay up to date, wishlist the game here on Steam and come join us on the official Realpolitiks HQ Discord server, we would love to hear what you think!

We will see you on the world stage soon - on Earth, in space, and beyond!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2298690/Realpolitiks_3_Earth_and_Beyond/

notes.title: Realpolitiks II update v1.09 is out now
notes.notes:
Greetings,

Brand new patch for Reapolitiks II has just arrived, fixing many bugs and issues. 

Changelog:

 The frequency of the outbreak of a rebellion has been changed - it shouldn't happen that often now
 UN eagerly adopts resolutions on an unrecognized player's country
 Changed the liberation mechanic - now it can recreate already nonexisting historic countries - If the country ceased to exist and the provinces in its historic territory were liberated, the devastated country would return to the world map 
 Improvements and fixes in effects' values visualization
 Fixed missing music after loading saved game
 Fixed a bug where a saved game become corrupted and couldn't be loaded due to being stuck in the loading screen
 Fixed the issue where sometimes after loading the game some armies were bugged and unclickable or unable to be moved
 Fixed the issue where sometimes after loading the game some war theatres were bugged and unclickable or unable to resolve 
 Fixed some rare issues with changing province's owner¨
 Localization fixes
 Fixed an issue where incorrectly assigned armies caused the game to freeze
 Fixed the problem where after breaking a bloc, the notification displayed the wrong flag of the country we are fighting


One more thing to add - a fan-made Japanese localization can now be downloaded from this link. It has not been officially made by the developer, but it has been tested by the players and should be perfectly usable.

Thank you for playing Realpolitiks II, have a good one!

notes.title: Realpolitiks II new update coming tomorrow and save file compatibility
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992101/e711e9067c88bfe8c1ef4d680f9c1f62148afa35.png

Hello everyone!

The time has finally come! After many delays, unexpected setbacks, last-minute bug discoveries, tears and coffee in equal amounts, hours of QA and dramatic mental breakdowns we are finally able to release the long-awaited update that was previously scheduled to go live on April 8th.

This is an important announcement for all current Realpolitiks II players, since the update will make your save files unplayable. As we’ve previously stated, a few of the most severe bugs were rooted deeply within some of the most basic game mechanisms. While this update brings some much needed improvements for the game’s quality, it turned out to be impossible to keep the old saves compatible with the new version. This is why we would like to inform you in advance, so you can plan your current games accordingly.

On the brighter side, besides an incredible amount of fixes, the update brings in some new and exciting content such as the highly anticipated post-apocalyptic campaign we were all really excited to work on. We hope that you find it fun as well!

The update will go live tomorrow, April 30th between 4 and 5 pm CEST.

Once again, we wanted to thank our amazing community for bringing us new ideas, constant feedback and endless support. There is no doubt we wouldn’t have been able to go this far without such great players.We’re looking forward to hearing your impressions!

Best,
Jujubee Team

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1248060/Realpolitiks_II/

notes.title: Realpolitiks II update postponed
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992101/e711e9067c88bfe8c1ef4d680f9c1f62148afa35.png

Hello everyone! We have an announcement regarding the big update that was scheduled for release today. As mentioned before, it’s a huge update that deals with some of the most severe bugs in the game and it’s something the development team has worked on really hard for the last month. We really wanted to bring it your way as soon as we could; unfortunately, just as we were coming to a close of the testing process we have stumbled upon a rare, but quite impactful bug. The team did its best to diagnose and eliminate it, but it seems that we weren’t able to pinpoint its causes accurately enough to get rid of it completely in this brief period of time. 

We know that you - our community - were more than patient with us during those past few months and we hate to tell you that we need to delay a feature once more; however we feel that this is the best choice, with the alternative being rolling out a release that can potentially introduce a new, serious issue.
For now, we haven’t had the time to gather enough data to give you a new estimated release date for this update. We will inform you of any news as soon as we can. Once again, thank you so much for your patience and understanding.

notes.title: Realpolitiks II full release postponed until May
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992101/d9c5add3f9e0af2a3264d892917e614ef51e80b3.jpg

Hello everyone.

Today we’re coming to you with two announcements regarding the future of Realpolitiks II.

Let us open this message by saying that even though it’s not always explicitly apparent, we always listen to all of the community voices with utmost attention. We are aware that Realpolitiks II has been a troubled release and some of the bugs you’ve encountered were deeply rooted in the  way we approached things at the very beginning of the production. We know you have anticipated this announcement and so we have come to the same conclusion some of you have already voiced here, on this channel, multiple times: we are postponing the final release of the game until May 12th, 2021. This will allow us to not only polish the game and, more importantly, test it thoroughly with the help of a specialised company, but also prepare a way better release for you and all the future Realpolitiks II players.

The other announcement we’re less eager to make is the fact that with the upcoming update that’s scheduled to go live April 8th, your old saves will not work anymore. As much as we tried to avoid it, we need to resolve underlying issues that are causing some of the most troubling, game-breaking bugs that are causing some players to be unable to enjoy the game. We know some of you have put many hours into playing Realpolitiks II, but as we’ve previously stated, some of those problems date back to the beginning of the development and to fix them we need to make some fundamental changes in our systems. Each way of preserving your saved games we have tested out was impossible to implement without introducing new, severe optimization issues. At the same time we would like to assure you that the upcoming update is one of the biggest ones yet, including not only much needed fixes, but also the previously announced post-apocalyptic scenario along with other content that was planned for the full launch.

We hope that you receive this information with understanding and as always, we thank you for your overwhelming support and help in making Realpolitiks II the game we wanted it to be throughout the whole Early Access period.

Best regards,

Jujubee team

notes.title: Realpolitiks II gets a new release date!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992101/96141a025d85f2d954adefede43b547210c23833.png

Hello everyone,

We have some news regarding the release date of Realpolitiks II outside of Early Access on Steam. To cut the long story short, we are pushing it a little bit further - to the first half of April. 

The ones who have joined our Discord channel, know that our developers regularly communicate with the players; new patches to Realpolitiks II are released steadily every few days, with a brief break in the midst of the Holiday period. Thanks to the continuous support of our community, we were able to pinpoint more and more rare bugs and issues we are confident we can fix, if given more time. Currently our main focus lies on optimizing the game as much as possible, fixing the bugs reported by the community and introducing some quality-of-life updates. We’ve also received tons of incredible feedback with some really great ideas and suggestions regarding various improvements that we would love to include in the final release. In conclusion - we simply want to make sure we’re releasing a truly polished game the strategy fans deserve. At the same time we’re trying not to feed into the crunch culture that plagues the gaming industry. That’s why it is unavoidable for us to push the release date of Realpolitiks II a bit into the future.

We would also like to take this opportunity to thank our wonderful community. You guys are the best. Thank you for understanding and for your continuous support.

Cheers,

Realpolitiks II Development Team

notes.title: Realpolitiks II - Release Postponed and Early Access Announcement
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36992101/689c56dd6e89271a5dd81d7e916c2c5feea15908.png

Hello everyone,

We are sorry to announce that we have decided to postpone the release of Realpolitiks II for two more weeks to November 18.

We did our best and worked very hard to keep our initial release date as promised but due to the challenges we are facing caused by the pandemic, the restrictions we have while working remotely, but also the overwhelming feedback we got from the community, we wanted to give the project a bit more time to bring you a complete and engaging experience we can all be proud of.

Because of this and also taking into consideration the restricted release options we have due to the Holiday season that is approaching, in order to avoid the delay and having you wait until the next year, we have decided to release the game into Early Access first with the full launch following early in 2021. But most of all - while the title is in a very good state content wise and will be fully playable and functional on November 18, we want to engage all of you into the further development of Realpolitiks II and use the community's feedback to improve and polish the game even more.

With 208 fully playable countries, 2 campaigns from the start and 1500 provinces, many new features and mechanics the game is huge. Despite the extensive QA we have had, it is nearly impossible to fully test the gameplay for each nation we feature in the game and we want Realpolitiks II to be balanced perfectly. In the end we are doing it all for you guys, we want to make sure we are going in the right direction with the further development, including a new post-apo scenario that we plan to have available before February.

Until then, we will keep you updated with new content and information about the game.

We understand that many of you might feel upset, as we do as well, but this is the best decision we could take so we will not disappoint you with the quality of the game. We appreciate your patience and we look forward to delivering you Realpolitiks II!

Team Jujubee and 1C Entertainment
